intro: Lavana is where conversations flow naturally, comfort feels inevitable, and every detail invites you to settle in. Lavana's presence in your home feels instinctive, calm, and quietly essential.

features.title: Natural wood artistry
features.text: Crafted with solid Acacia wood, Lavana brings natural warmth and visual strength to your space, creating a refined foundation that feels timeless, sturdy, and beautifully grounded.

features.title: Soft, breathable comfort
features.text: Bouclé fabric’s textured elegance, celebrated in mid-century design circles, brings both visual warmth and calm refinement to your environment. The fabric settles beautifully while resisting wear, ensuring your sofa remains inviting through years of everyday use.

features.title: Refined support with mid-back silhouette
features.text: The thoughtfully scaled mid-back design strikes a harmonious balance between supportive seating and spatial openness. The gently reclined backrest even invites sideways positioning for unhurried conversations, transforming your sofa into a natural gathering point.

features.title: Intuitive integrated wooden disk tray
features.text: A minimalist wooden disk tray tucked into the armrest at wrist height becomes your go-to spot for remote controls, beverage cups, or snack bowls, keeping necessities within arm's reach while maintaining a curated aesthetic.

features.title: Discreet rear shelf for hidden organisation
features.text: A hidden ledge runs along the sofa's back edge when positioned against the wall, becoming your private repository for books, devices, remotes, and personal items. This concealed storage honours the reality that homes need functional spaces without visual noise.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
